title: Mini Design Board
summary: Students review core Module 1 language, study a model board, listen to a short model presentation, build a labeled board from a selected image, draft short board text in structured lines, revise one part, submit a final mini design board, and present it with teacher support.
essential_question: How can I present one simple fashion design idea clearly in English?
professional_context: Week 14 connects English to first-step design-board sharing, studio presentation, and future portfolio-style communication. Students combine garment, fabric, detail, inspiration, and revision language into one small but reusable fashion artifact.
language_focus: integrated garment, parts, silhouette, color palette, fabric, detail, inspiration, rationale, and revision language
presentation frames such as This board shows ... and The figure is wearing ...
design explanation frames such as I imagine this garment in ..., This design is inspired by ..., and I chose ... because ...
revision language for one clearer final version
teacher_preparation: Preview the model mini design board, the cumulative review board, the reusable image A to image D gallery, and the listening script before class.

Keep the core Week 14 frames visible: This board shows ..., The figure is wearing ..., I imagine this garment in ..., This design is inspired by ..., I chose ... because ..., and The overall look is ....
Keep the main writing path structured and short. The draft and final submission should use a title plus five required lines and one optional challenge line rather than a paragraph or word-count task.
Check that the model board text, listening script, questions, and correct answers all match exactly for Activity 4.
Prepare quick support for article use, is wearing, because clauses, and pronunciation of silhouette, palette, neckline, and inspiration.
Decide whether students will show the reusable gallery on screen, with printouts, or through a projected board during the teacher presentation session.
student_deliverables: Completion of the Week 14 opener selections about the sections of a mini design board.
Completion of one cumulative matching set using the Week 14 review board.
Reading-comprehension responses about the model mini design board.
Listening-comprehension responses aligned to one short model mini-board presentation.
One selected image key plus eight saved label matches for a chosen design.
One structured draft with a title, five required lines, and one optional challenge line.
One saved revision target plus one revised line after the checklist review.
One final structured mini design board submission for teacher review.
One short teacher-observed final mini presentation with speaking-frame support.
